tools.name: find_skill
tools.description: Describe what you need in plain words (e.g. 'is this wallet sanctioned', 'earthquakes near Tokyo'). Returns matching tools with price, input schema and an example call. Free.

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Poll a task returned by a paid tool: pass its task_id and the read_token from the task's access block. Returns its state and, once complete, the signed result. Free.

tools.name: cancel_task
tools.description: Cancel a task that is still queued, using the cancel_token from its access block. The payment authorization is released and nothing is charged. Free.

tools.name: data_attest_snapshot
tools.description: Signed statement of the value Ellimist recorded at or just before time T: Aave USDC rates, native USDC supply or the Treasury curve. For backtests, audits and disputes. Price: $0.01 USDC per call via x402 (no account). Not charged if it fails.

tools.name: data_chain_account

tools.name: data_chain_erc20_transfers
tools.description: Use this to list recent ERC-20 Transfer events for a token, optionally only those to or from one address (up to 2,000 recent blocks): incoming/outgoing payments, flows. Price: $0.005 USDC per call via x402 (no account). Not charged if it fails.

tools.name: data_defi_aave_rates
tools.description: Use this to get the current USDC lending (supply) APR and variable borrow APR on Aave V3 (Base or Ethereum), read from the Aave pool contract at a finalized block. Price: $0.005 USDC per call via x402 (no account). Not charged if it fails.

tools.name: data_defi_yield_vs_tbill
tools.description: Use this to compare parking USDC on Aave V3 with a 3-month U.S. Treasury bill right now: Aave's supply APR and APY, the T-bill yield, and the spread in basis points, with both source dates. Data comparison, not advice; Aave carries smart-contract risk a T-bill does not. Price: $0.01 USDC per call vi

tools.name: data_macro_bls
tools.description: Use this to get U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics series: CPI inflation, unemployment rate, payrolls, wages and other BLS series IDs (e.g. CUUR0000SA0, LNS14000000). Official public-domain data. Price: $0.005 USDC per call via x402 (no account). Not charged if it fails.

tools.name: data_macro_recession_signals
tools.description: Use this to answer 'are recession signals on?' in one call: Treasury yield-curve inversion (10y-2y and 10y-3m), the Sahm rule from BLS unemployment, and real 10-year and 3-month rates after CPI inflation. Each with its official source date. Data, not advice. Price: $0.01 USDC per call via x402 (no a

tools.name: data_macro_treasury_curve
tools.description: Use this to get the U.S. Treasury par yield curve (1-month to 30-year yields) by day, with 10y-2y and 10y-3m spreads for recession and rates signals. Official data. Price: $0.005 USDC per call via x402 (no account). Not charged if it fails.

tools.name: data_risk_ofac
tools.description: Use this to check whether a crypto wallet address is sanctioned: matches it against digital currency addresses on the official U.S. Treasury OFAC SDN list (KYC/AML screening, compliance). Price: $0.005 USDC per call via x402 (no account). Not charged if it fails.

tools.name: exchange_build_swap
tools.description: Unsigned approval + swap transactions for the best route. Your agent signs and broadcasts from its own wallet; Ellimist never takes custody. Conversions are executed by third-party smart contracts (routed by LI.FI) that may fail or be exploited; funds may be lost and transactions are irreversible. P

tools.name: exchange_quote
tools.description: Best route to convert any token to any token across chains: output, minimum output, fees, gas, time; with 'alternatives', other routes to compare. Sanctions-screened. tools.name: exchange_status
tools.description: Track a broadcast swap or bridge transfer until it completes. Price: $0 USDC per call via x402 (no account). Not charged if it fails.

tools.name: exchange_supported
tools.description: Use this (free) to see which chains Ellimist can convert between and, for one chain, which tokens with their USD prices. Price: $0 USDC per call via x402 (no account). Not charged if it fails.

tools.name: quantum_exposure_index
tools.description: Use this to see how much tracked ETH sits in addresses whose public key is already revealed, and so would be exposed to a future quantum computer: daily index with history, shares of tracked balance (revealed, hidden, contract), counts and coverage. Aggregate only; no addresses. Price: $0.01 USDC pe

tools.name: quantum_portfolio_index_tracking
tools.description: Use this to pick K assets and weights that track an index with minimal tracking error, from your own asset and index return series. Price: $0.05 USDC per call via x402 (no account). Not charged if it fails.

tools.name: quantum_portfolio_optimize
tools.description: Use this to compute mean-variance portfolio weights from your own returns or covariance, optionally limited to a maximum number of assets; QAOA asset selection next to an exact classical baseline. Price: $0.05 USDC per call via x402 (no account). Not charged if it fails.

tools.name: quantum_pq_exposure
tools.description: Use this to score how exposed an Ethereum or Bitcoin wallet is to future quantum attacks (revealed public keys, address reuse, Taproot) with migration advice. Price: $0.02 USDC per call via x402 (no account). Not charged if it fails.

tools.name: quantum_risk_var_cvar
tools.description: Use this to compute Value-at-Risk and CVaR (expected shortfall) with confidence intervals for your portfolio returns, returned as a signed attestation a lender or counterparty can verify. Price: $0.05 USDC per call via x402 (no account). Not charged if it fails.

tools.name: quantum_routing_split_order
tools.description: For large conversions: probes route output at several sizes and splits the order across routes to maximize total output versus a single route. Price: $0.05 USDC per call via x402 (no account). Not charged if it fails.
